nodes.description: Public boolean flag controlling whether tickets can be bought; gates buyTickets and is mutated by openLottery/closeLotteryAndPickWinner/setMaxTokenBuyin.
POWM token contract instance at fixed address 0xA146...BA2B; all buy/transfer/myTokens calls go through this external contract.
Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; anchors the onlyOwner modifier.
mapping(uint256 => address) of ticket index to gambler; written in buyTickets and read when picking the winner.
mapping(address => uint256) recording the number of tokens each player bought in the round.
mapping(address => uint256) storing the round in which an address last bought; prevents repeat buys in the same round.
Counter of issued tickets for the current round; also used as the modulo divisor in winner selection (can be 0).
Current round number, incremented by openLottery and copied into last_round_bought.
Cached token balance held by the lottery, refreshed from maths.myTokens() after buys/donations.
Referrer address passed to maths.buy; initially msg.sender, later overwritten with the winner.
Upper bound on tokens purchasable per transaction; owner-settable while the lottery is closed.
Constructor initializing current_round=1, owner and masternode_referrer to msg.sender.
Payable donation path that forwards msg.value to maths.buy and refreshes numTokensInLottery.
Payable ticket purchase: external token buy, SafeMath accounting, ticket loop, and per-address bookkeeping.
onlyOwner setter for MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN; only callable while the lottery is closed.
onlyOwner state transition that increments current_round, opens the lottery and resets the ticket counter.
Payable fallback that forwards non-POWM senders into buyTickets, making it reentrant when receiving ETH.
onlyOwner round settlement: picks a pseudo-random winner, transfers all tokens, and pushes the ETH balance to the winner.
External payable call maths.buy.value(msg.value)(masternode_referrer) executed before all internal accounting is finalized.
External maths.transfer(winner, exact_tokens) whose boolean return value is never checked.
winner.transfer(address(this).balance) sending ETH to an attacker-controlled address before state is fully settled, enabling reentrancy via the fallback.
uint256(keccak256(block.blockhash(block.number - 1))) % num_tickets_current_round: miner-influenced randomness plus potential division by zero.
SafeMath.sub(tokens_after, tokens_before).div(1e18) arithmetic used to derive the number of tokens bought.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership, ticket assignment, buy-in bookkeeping and modifier checks.
Block-level context (block.number/blockhash) used as the randomness seed for winner selection.
Input amount passed to setMaxTokenBuyin and assigned to MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.
Cached maths.myTokens() value read before the external buy call.
Cached maths.myTokens() value read after the external buy call.
Number of tokens bought, computed with SafeMath.sub/div and bounded by MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN.
uint8 loop counter used to allocate up to 25 tickets to the buyer.
Index derived from the block randomness modulo the ticket count, used to look up the winner.
Address looked up from the gamblers mapping at winning_number; receives tokens and ETH.
Cached maths.myTokens() balance transferred out to the winner during settlement.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the onlyOwner access control anchor from untrusted caller data.
Constructor sets masternode_referrer = msg.sender, taking the referrer directly from the caller.
buyTickets forwards msg.value into the external maths.buy call before completing its own accounting.
donateToLottery forwards msg.value into the external maths.buy call.
After the external buy, numTokensInLottery is refreshed from maths.myTokens().
last_round_bought is keyed by the caller-supplied msg.sender.
Every allocated ticket in gamblers is written to msg.sender.
token_buyins is keyed by the caller-supplied msg.sender.
last_round_bought[msg.sender] is set to the current_round value.
buyTickets derives the token count using SafeMath.sub(...).div(1e18), a critical arithmetic step.
The SafeMath subtraction/division result becomes tokens_bought, which bounds the ticket loop.
num_tickets_current_round is the modulo divisor; zero tickets would cause a division-by-zero revert.
Winner selection depends on miner-influenceable block data (blockhash/block.number), making the result block-context dependent.
The computed modulo result indexes gamblers to produce the winner address.
gamblers[winning_number] is read from the ticket mapping to select the winner.
closeLotteryAndPickWinner invokes maths.transfer for the entire token balance without checking the return value.
The cached exact_tokens balance is the amount passed into maths.transfer.
Settlement pushes address(this).balance to an attacker-selected winner before the round is fully finalized.
masternode_referrer is overwritten with the winner address during settlement.
The winner address flows into the masternode_referrer state variable.
tokens_before caches maths.myTokens() immediately before the external buy.
tokens_after caches maths.myTokens() immediately after the external buy.
exact_tokens caches maths.myTokens() during settlement.
The ticket loop counter i is driven by tokens_bought inside buyTickets.
Each loop iteration increments num_tickets_current_round.
buyTickets requires isLotteryOpen == true before any purchase logic runs.
setMaxTokenBuyin requires isLotteryOpen == false.
openLottery requires isLotteryOpen == false before opening.
closeLotteryAndPickWinner requires isLotteryOpen == true before settling.
onlyOwner guard on setMaxTokenBuyin compares msg.sender to owner.
onlyOwner guard on openLottery compares msg.sender to owner.
onlyOwner guard on closeLotteryAndPickWinner compares msg.sender to owner.
MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN bounds the tokens_bought value accepted by buyTickets.
ETH pushed to the winner runs their receive logic, which can re-enter this contract's payable fallback.
The fallback forwards non-POWM senders into buyTickets, completing the reentrancy path.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokens parameter exists only to write the MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN state variable inside setMaxTokenBuyin.
tokens_before is a temporary snapshot of maths.myTokens() that feeds the SafeMath subtraction.
tokens_after is the second operand of the SafeMath subtraction and has no independent role.
tokens_bought is the direct result of the SafeMath sub/div expression and drives the guard and loop.
The uint8 loop counter i is purely a loop index local to buyTickets.
winning_number is the modulo result of the blockhash randomness expression.
winner is the address resolved for the ETH payout, so it merges into the winner.transfer operation.
exact_tokens is only the amount argument for the external maths.transfer call.
